title: Serverware Policy Shadow Observation v1
$comment: Exactly one signed observation accounts for each contiguous ingress sequence. Independently signed ingressEvidence authoritatively accounts for admission, while a distinct activeDecision envelope authoritatively records the terminal active result; the shadow signer cannot author either role. Native verification exactly joins assignment/load/policy/runtime/boot identities and requires both signed roles to match the outer result. Request commitments are keyed HMACs over canonical protected facts plus assignment payload digest/revision, boot identity, ingress sequence, key epoch, and signed observed time. The complete expansion set and root are deterministically derived by the verifier from the signed active/candidate evaluations, signed PolicyAuthorityAnalysis, compiled semantic authority binding, and pilot membership; evaluator omissions, duplicates, and extras fail.

ledgerPredecessor.$comment: Native verification requires eventOrdinal == predecessorEventOrdinal + 1 and recomputes resultingHeadSha256 from the exact canonical record.

runtimeLedgerEvent.$comment: Phase and counters are derived from this closed event. Failure phase is derived from terminalReason by the native exhaustive matcher; no independent caller phase or accounting kind exists.

spoolAppendReservationReceipt.$comment: The native verifier requires eventOrdinal == predecessorEventOrdinal + 1 and admits this capability only after pinned Ed25519, current trust/revocation, persistence and immutable retrieval verification.

activeMutableEffectKind.$comment: Each listed mutation is a separate prepare -> signed durable barrier -> verified one-use permit -> commit operation. JIT reserve, dispatch, complete, and abort are distinct mutations; complete and abort are mutually exclusive terminals for one reservation. The same fresh-receipt rule applies independently to quota reserve/commit/cancel, durable-budget reserve/commit/cancel, release reserve/dispatch/complete/abort, Gmail registration and every Gmail ledger transition.

activeEffectPreparation.$comment: effectIdSha256 is the serverware.policyShadowActiveEffectPreparation/v1 domain hash over the canonical generation, ingress, effect kind, intent and prepared-state binding.

activeEffectBarrierReceipt.$comment: This is the exact unverified ActiveEffectBarrierReceiptWire shape. Its signed canonical preimage inserts the fixed active-effect-barrier role. Only the native VerifiedActiveEffectPermit produced after pinned Ed25519, current trust/revocation, persistence and immutable retrieval verification is a one-use commit capability.

activeEffectCommitReceipt.$comment: This is the exact unverified ActiveEffectCommitReceiptWire shape. Its signed canonical preimage inserts the fixed active-effect-commit role. The receipt consumes the exact barrier receipt and binds the terminal result. Unknown or reconcile-required outcomes remain hard-unready until custody reconciliation.

publicationReconciliationReceipt.$comment: Native verification resolves the publication signer only from the assignment custody-publication-reconciliation binding, requires exact key ID, DER-SPKI, and public-key-material equality with the signed authority-analysis publication requirement, and accepts only a durable published-state receipt into publicationReceiptCount/root.

custodyEvidence.$comment: The verifier resolves the closed receipt wire objects by immutable retrieval proof, joins every receipt to this observation, and recomputes exact ordered roots. dispatchBarrierReceiptSha256 is the primary dispatch barrier and must be non-null exactly when dispatchBarrierReceiptCount is positive. activeEffectBarrierReceiptCount must equal activeEffectCommitReceiptCount; their roots bind every prepare-barrier and exact terminal receipt. terminalReceiptCount/root cover only terminal-append-role receipts and include the exact terminalSpillReceiptSha256 joined to the active decision. publicationReceiptCount/root cover only publication-reconciliation-role receipts and include publicationReconciliationReceiptSha256. Both counts are positive for every observation, remain separate from spill and effect roots, and all counts/roots bind into custodyEvidenceRootSha256.

failureRuntimeLedgerEvent.$comment: This exhaustive pairing is the wire projection of PolicyShadowTerminalReason::spool_phase; impossible reason/phase combinations are rejected.

generation.$comment: Native verification derives every field from the verified assignment and load receipt, recomputes the single generationId, and requires generationTombstoneEpoch <= generationEpoch. Runtime code uses this signed identity directly; a retired generation cannot be reconstructed from a later load receipt.

accountingTransportExcluded.$comment: A sampled outer CONNECT is transport-only accounting. Decrypted inner HTTP is the covered ingress, so this result is truthful and non-invalidating.

activePolicyPlan.$comment: Native verification recomputes policyPlanSha256 and the domain-separated effectIntentsSha256, then derives the exact ordered effect requirement set from this typed plan.

semanticExpansionCell.$comment: Native verification recomputes cellSha256 from every other field, requires compiler-analysis membership, and enforces positive per-cell coverage and the signed per-cell total/write caps.

derivedExpansionSet.$comment: Native verification derives the exact strictly ordered cells from signed evidence and recomputes the domain-separated Merkle root. The empty set uses the canonical empty Merkle root.

activeEffectRequirements.$comment: Native verification requires strict enum order and exact equality with requirements deterministically derived from the embedded typed ActivePolicyPlan. Every JIT, quota, durable-budget, and release lifecycle mutation has distinct evidence. For mutually exclusive success/abort or commit/cancel branches, the non-selected terminal is present as not-reached rather than being omitted.

pilotMembershipEvidence.$comment: Native verification derives principal and route leaves from HMAC-verified protected facts and recomputes both pilot roots with serverware.policyPilotMembershipNode/v1.

responseObligationBinding.$comment: Request/decision expansion coverage remains positive when active enforcement legitimately did not dispatch. Only the applied variant can satisfy response-comparability coverage.

responseComparison.$comment: Only bounded-exact evidence reconstructed from an authenticated signed and runtime-attested transport receipt binding runtime, generation, request, peer, raw head, raw body, framing, and completion is comparable. The verifier derives status, physical headers, framing, and decoded body and rejects parsed-adapter mismatches. Not-applicable active non-dispatch is valid authority coverage but is not comparable response coverage.

latencySamples.$comment: Only non-null samples enter histograms. Null is never converted to zero.

activeEffectResolution.$comment: terminalEvidence must be strictly ordered and contain exactly one terminal state for every requirement derived from the embedded active plan. Missing, duplicate, extra, or generic decision-JSON commitments are rejected.

authorityKeyIndependenceSha256.$comment: Exact assignment authorityKeyIndependence.independenceRootSha256; every envelope and custody receipt signer is re-resolved against this set.

activeDecision.$comment: Native verification pins this envelope to the distinct active-decision key and exactly matches the outer active result.

previousObservationSha256.$comment: Sequence one anchors to generationId; later values equal the immediately preceding verified observation envelope digest.
